mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERM_CHANGE_LOG (CHANGED_AT, ACTOR_EMP_NO, TARGET_EMP_NO, TARGET_ROLE, ITEM, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, EMP_VERIFIED) VALUES (#{changedAt}, #{actorEmpNo}, #{targetEmpNo}, #{targetRole}, #{item}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{empVerified})
mapper.select: SELECT CHG_ID, CHANGED_AT, ACTOR_EMP_NO, TARGET_EMP_NO, TARGET_ROLE, ITEM, BEFORE_VALUE, AFTER_VALUE, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, EMP_VERIFIED FROM PERM_CHANGE_LOG TARGET_EMP_NO = #{targetEmpNo} ORDER BY CHG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
